author: /root/p1345_baseline

authorization.scope: Write and execute P1345 through its declared gates; authorization does not waive stop conditions or expand public/default/pipeline behavior.

observables: Exact authority-rooted canonical full-token sequence for each of the 38 private observation capsules, ignoring only whitespace and comments.
Exact capsule ID, path, physical owner, insert-or-replace kind, anchors, inverse replacement bytes and complete token digest.
Inverse normalization of all 38 capsules recovers the 12 complete candidate-free file hashes.
The exact inherited nineteen H00D/H00S/H01-H16 binding rows and single carrier/ledger/facade boundary from P1344.
Independent compiled A/B evidence for reachability, fresh inputs, identities, raw causality, cardinality and read-only projection.
Strict authority root, duplicate-key rejection, corpus/checker/root pins and deterministic normal/repeat/reverse classification.
non_observables_and_scope_outs: Whitespace and comments inside a canonical capsule are not token observables.
Token equality is an architectural gate for private observation capsules, not Typst language mechanical parity.
No P1340/P1339 closure, NT01-NT06, retention, discard, invalidation, terminal policy or general functional equivalence.
No public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase change.
No HIR/MIR rustc_private dependency under the frozen toolchain because rustc-dev is absent.

unknown_policy.source_and_authority: Unsupported grammar, ambiguous identity, absent evidence, schema/hash/root drift, missing runtime or exhausted budget are Violated, never Unknown.
unknown_policy.corpus: Corpus fields do not self-declare classification or witness.
unknown_policy.only_allowed_unknown: One deliberately opaque probe whose Unknown is derived by the checker from a fresh verifier challenge, pinned executable hash and primitive observations after every earlier predicate passes.
unknown_policy.forbidden: Missing, reused, candidate-emitted, challenge-mismatched or executable-hash-mismatched opaque receipt is Violated.

read_allowlist: the twelve L0/consumer pairs frozen by p1344-l0-freeze-r1.json
the installed Rust toolchain and Cargo manifests
baseline_protocol.forbidden: candidate, contract, oracle, tests, productive code and verdict correction

read_allowlist: protected P1344 contract, binding and adversarial blocker
contract_author.forbidden: candidate, oracle, corpus, attack, test, seal and implementation

read_allowlist: protected P1344 controls and attacks named by the contract
oracle_author.forbidden: productive candidate, full corpus, adversarial verdict, seal and implementation

read_allowlist: P1345 contract, baseline and oracle artifacts
adversary.forbidden: candidate, oracle correction, contract correction, full corpus, seal and implementation

preseal_verifier.forbidden: editing any judged input, candidate or test

read_allowlist: frozen L0, P1345 contract and valid preseal; no candidate patch
ab_tester.forbidden: contract, oracle, baseline, candidate implementation and verdict

read_allowlist: frozen L0, P1345 contract, capsule baseline, valid preseal and frozen RED receipt
implementer.forbidden: baseline, contract, oracle, corpus, test, seal and certificate

read_allowlist: all sealed inputs, candidate outputs and independent A/B evidence
final_verifier.forbidden: editing any judged input, test or candidate

budgets.contract: one initial revision plus at most one revision for a newly measured contract failure class
budgets.oracle: at most two focal revisions, each with a new witness, public cause and measured discriminatory gain
budgets.stop: same cause/vector twice; any survivor, positive regression, score below 1.0, protected drift, opaque self-attestation, absent real runtime, ADR-0127 expansion or weakened negative blocks seal/certificate

isolation.separation_basis: independent authorities, explicit inputs, causal order, write allowlists and artifact hashes

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys are valid. Duplicate keys, undeclared capability, role fusion or protected-input drift invalidates downstream authority.
